author: Brzeziu
quote: A few words for all you teary-eyed Zelda fans. This is exactly what happens when you’re a pathetic, weak, insecure idiot who trashes another great title without even playing it—simply because you’re such a psycho fan that you feel the need to spew venom at everything else, convinced that your own favorite is the absolute best. Go ahead and keep playing your little flute for the next 50 years, contributing absolutely nothing to modern gaming. Not that I care to send you any regards..
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: Brzeziu
quote: A vast, living world, tons of activities, and the most compelling side missions the series has ever seen. Not everyone might like a story featuring both a man and a woman, but that doesn’t bother me—quite the opposite, in fact. At least we don’t have an African American character constantly shouting "brother, brother" every other second. There’s a wealth of new animations and features for both characters and vehicles. And a quick word to the haters who are review-bombing this series with zeros: you’re pathetic, weak, and jealous losers. We, as GTA fans, never did that to you—we couldn’t care less about your "reheated leftovers" ****, where the biggest highlight is playing a flute; we just focused on our own series instead. You haven’t even played this game, yet you slapped it with the lowest possible score. You’re the worst kind of people, and I can’t wait to see the looks on your faces when Rockstar takes home the "Game of the Year" award. Oh, and one more thing—I’m giving a zero to that boring, rehashed *Zelda* game, since I’ve played exactly as much of it as you’ve played of *GTA*. Don’t expect any regards from me.
